verdict.rationale: A daily user confirms Warp sends a notification when a long-running command finishes (warp-comm-9). Command-aware output grouping into Blocks is also evidenced (warp-comm-8, warp-docs-21), which points to shell-integration-based command tracking. There is no first-party documentation of this, and the other named features are not evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party docs on shell integration, per-command exit status display, command duration tracking, documented long-command notification settings.
